quotes.text: You might be considering a party barge or pedal bus for a bachelorette party in Nashville. I urge you to go for the barge. It was HOT AF and we were all so glad to have a boozy bus tour that we didn't have to peddle on. Our tour guide from the photo was great!! We danced and drank the whole time. He took us to a bar and sang a song and serenaded the bride. The bar was just our party too. It was so much fun! I'd definitely recommend it. Great way to see the city.

We had a great trip on the Party Barge tonight. Our whole crew was excited before and we could hardly get everyone off at the end. Kenny are driver had the cooler ready and full of ice and was extremely personable. He gave us some options on stops and was the designated photographer for photo opportunities. We partied like we were all 21 again even though most of us were 2 and some 3 times that. Thanks Kenny and Party Barge for a great night out in Nashville!!!

We did the barge as part of a bachelorette bash in Nashville and it was a group favorite. Ronnie, our driver, was such a delight. He was kind, funny, and took us on a wonderful trip around the city. Not only do you get to see a ton of sights - you have an amazing experience you won't get elsewhere! You can choose to play your own music and it's BYOB. I can't imagine this trip without this experience.

We had so much fun! With everything going on with corona right now it was great to be able to celebrate my best friend for her bachelorette with Captain Kenny. We were able to go to all the great instagram worthy spots and loved his recommendation on where to eat after we finished. We would love to do it again for sure!
